Attachment.description:
A file attached to a message.

`id` = the upload id = the attachment id (S15). URLs are signed, path-absolute and valid for
55–60 minutes (`url_expires_at`); every render inside one 5-minute window gives the same
strings. `width`/`height` are the displayed size (after EXIF orientation) of an image or the
poster frame of a video.

content_type.description: The stored (sniffed) MIME type, not the served one (S15 §10).

height.description: Image or video height in pixels.

inline.description: Served `inline` (only sniffed image, video and audio types, S15 §10.4).

kind.description: The kind (S15; payloads from before S15 read as `other`).

media_pending.description: A thumbnail or poster is still being made; `attachments_updated` follows.

poster_url.description: Signed poster-frame URL (videos, when the server has `ffmpeg`).

preview_url.description: Signed large-preview URL (images wider than 1,920 px, BMP, TIFF).

thumbnail_url.description: Signed thumbnail URL (images, and video posters).

url_expires_at.description: When the signed URLs stop working (S15; absent in payloads from before S15).

width.description: Image or video width in pixels.

FileKind.description: What a file is, from its sniffed content type (S15 §10).

oneOf.description: A raster image (`image/*` from the magic table, or SVG).
A document: PDF, text, office formats.

description: One file in a channel: the attachment and where it lives.

attachment.description: The attachment, with fresh signed URLs.

message_id.description: The message it is attached to.

thread_root_id.description: The thread root, for files on replies.
